biotools.summary: Pv3Rs is an R package that allows users to infer the cause (recrudescence, relapse, or reinfection) of Plasmodium vivax malaria recurrence using genetic data. It implements a statistical model to compute posterior probabilities of recurrence states and is freely available on CRAN under the GNU license.
